messages:
Priya Nair: Heads up — after int8 bring-up of qweights-7b the golden set A F1 went down ~1.8% vs fp16. attaching a short eval summary. anyone on dedupe/labeler to triage?
Jonah Li: on it. can you paste the eval JSON here? was the tokenizer/normalization changed between runs?
Priya Nair: eval gist: `{"model":"qweights-7b-int8","golden":"A","f1":0.912, "baseline_fp16_f1":0.930}`. tokenization flag `--normalize-html` was false for the int8 run (we usually set true).
Andre Gomez: interesting — int8 build pipeline didn't include the extra tokenizers wheel from 2025-03-08, so that could shift token offsets and affect exact-match metrics.
Maya Patel: labelers reported ~2.5% of golden examples in cohort A have conflicting annotations (two labelers disagreed on best answer). That will drag F1 down and could amplify an apparent regression. I flagged 120 examples in the UI.
Devon Chu: dedupe pipeline also had a hiccup last night — HTML-entity normalization step crashed for a small shard. hash collisions reintroduced ~300 items; run id `shard-2025-07-12-4`. I'm digging logs.
Priya Nair: ok makes sense. priority: (1) run dedupe fix and re-eval on deduped golden A, (2) spin int8 canary with tokenizer wheel included, (3) isolate relabeled vs original to see label noise impact. timeline?
Jonah Li: I can kick an int8 canary (2 nodes) once dedupe snapshot is ready. command I used locally:```bash
# build with tokenizer wheel
./build_quant.sh --model qweights-7b --wheels tokenizers-20250708.whl --mode int8
# run canary eval
python eval.py --model out/canary/qweights-7b-int8 --golden samples/goldenA_dedup.json --metrics f1,exact
```
Maya Patel: I'll prioritize relabel batch for the 120 flagged examples. ETA 6 hours for first pass, will send batch IDs.
Andre Gomez: Devon — can you push a dedupe re-run and attach the new fingerprint manifest? also include the small SQL I asked:```sql
-- find duplicate fingerprints
SELECT fp, count(*) c FROM samplebank WHERE shard='shard-2025-07-12-4' GROUP BY fp HAVING c>1;
```
Devon Chu: running now. quick note: the crash was due to an edgecase HTML like ` ` inside code fences — our normalizer skipped it. patching and re-running dedupe job against `s3://samplebank/ingest/2025-07-12`.
labelbot: dedupe_job_started: job=dedupe-422010-1 shard=2025-07-12-4
Priya Nair: great. once deduped golden is up, can someone run a small ablation: int8 + old tokenizer vs int8 + fixed tokenizer vs fp16? I want to quantify how much is quant vs tokenization vs label noise.
Jonah Li: yes — plan: three runs on same deduped set. I'll schedule them and post results here.
Maya Patel: if label noise explains >0.5% F1 drop we'll prioritize relabel permanently for that cohort. if not, we escalate to quant kernel team.
Andre Gomez: also add a quick script to compare token boundaries for the 120 flagged examples:```python
# check token differences
for ex in flagged:
  t1 = tok_old(ex['text'])
  t2 = tok_new(ex['text'])
  if t1 != t2:
    print(ex['id'], len(t1), len(t2))
```
Devon Chu: dedupe finished, manifest attached: s3://samplebank/manifests/dedupe-4220103456-manifest.json
ops-bot: canary cluster qweights-7b-int8 scheduled at 2025-07-12T18:30Z (2 nodes).
labelbot: relabel_batch_created: batch=goldenA_flagged_120 owner=Maya ETA=6h
Priya Nair: thanks all. action items: Jonah run three ablations once Devon's deduped snapshot is linked; Maya run relabel and surface conflicts; Andre follow token wheel packaging; I'll triage results and propose rollback/mitigation if regression persists. ping me on thread if anything blocks. :thumbsup:
